# gramlot-py-server 0.3.15

Serve only each page's declared collections, with verified startup snapshots and immutable fingerprinted URLs. Reuse page grammars and support typed example data companions. The runtime permits browser revalidation.

Known upstream debt: Kajenn 0.5.0 rewrites Content-Length to zero for HEAD responses. GET bodies and resource cache policy remain correct; the other adapters preserve representation length. Tracked in https://github.com/kajenn-org/kajenn/issues/77. The owner accepted this debt for the release.

The new prepared Python serverless exporter is not included.
